claims: Two Ripple-associated escrow objects totaling 1B XRP have FinishAfter eligibility at 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.
Tracker lists 31.4B XRP in 98 escrow objects across eight Ripple-associated accounts.
Trailing 12 monthly cycles: 12B released, 8.4B re-escrowed (70%), 3.6B net outside escrow.
limitations: Secondary tracker; raw XRPL JSON-RPC state was not obtained in this run.
FinishAfter is eligibility, not EscrowFinish, transfer, exchange deposit or sale.
Historical re-escrow is not a rule or guaranteed November outcome.

sources.publisher: TokenPost — Two Ripple Accounts Still Hold 1 Billion XRP Ahead of Nov. 1
claims: Two Ripple-labelled XRPL accounts each showed a 500M XRP balance on Oct29.
Four EscrowFinish transactions on Oct1 delivered 100M+400M to one account and 200M+300M to the other.
The report found no later outgoing XRP payment from either account through its Oct29 observation.
The same two accounts were associated with two Nov1 escrow objects containing another 500M each.
limitations: Wallet balances are dated Oct29, not a fresh Oct31 raw account-state check.
No sale, exchange deposit, OTC sale or current balance is established.
The 2B framing is 1B previously released and held plus 1B still escrowed/eligible, not 2B already unlocked or sold.

claims: Ripple says its products enabled more than $16T in transactions during 2025.
Ripple says it is on track to exit 2026 with $900M annualized product revenue run rate; this is a forward run-rate statement.
Ripple Payments is approaching $150B lifetime volume by year-end and serves 60+ payout markets.
Ripple reports 85+ licenses, 1,700+ institutional/corporate/enterprise customers and RLUSD around $2.6B market cap.
limitations: $16T covers the broader product portfolio, not XRP-routed payment volume.
$150B Ripple Payments lifetime volume does not mean all flows use XRP.
$900M is a projected annualized run rate, not audited 2026 revenue.

sources.publisher: BNY — Ripple collaboration expands custody and tokenized trade-finance exploration
claims: BNY supports XRP and RLUSD on its Digital Asset Custody platform for eligible clients.
BNY identifies itself as primary reserve custodian for RLUSD and cites an existing Ripple Prime custody relationship.
BNY and Ripple are exploring tokenized trade finance on XRPL with C2FO.
Direct RLUSD mint/redeem through BNY is a future initiative subject to BNY and regulatory approvals.
limitations: No XRP customer custody balances, client count or purchase volume are disclosed.
Custody availability does not prove XRP acquisition or collateral utilization.
Future mint/redeem and trade-finance plans are conditional.

sources.publisher: SBI Remit — XRP-based international money transfer service expansion
claims: SBI Remit says it has used Ripple Payments since 2017 and XRP as a bridge between fiat currencies for Japan-to-Philippines remittances since 2021.
The Sep2023 expansion covered bank-account payouts in the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.
SBI VC Trade sends XRP in response to SBI Remit payment requests in real time; Tranglo processes payouts.
SBI Remit says XRP bridge use reduces the need to pre-fund destination accounts.
limitations: This documents a 2023 use case, not current volume or inventory.
Payment throughput is not permanent XRP capital; tokens may turn over and be reused.
Current corridor volumes and XRP sourcing are undisclosed.

sources.publisher: Ripple — Ushering in the Future of Crypto Payments with Stablecoins
claims: Ripple positions XRP as a bridge asset for complex currency flows and lower-liquidity long-tail corridors.
Ripple positions RLUSD as dollar-denominated settlement for customers requiring USD stability and corridors where XRP is not required as a bridge.
Ripple describes RLUSD as additive and complementary to XRP.
Ripple states RLUSD is issued on XRPL and Ethereum.
limitations: Company strategy statement, not independent route-share evidence.
Substitution versus complementarity requires corridor-level routing and inventory data.

sources.publisher: Ripple — Ripple and Coinbase partner to expand access to RLUSD
claims: RLUSD launched on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail across XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Ripple said it would provide liquidity for RLUSD on Base.
Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral support was described as a later phase, not live at announcement.
limitations: RLUSD distribution is not native XRP buying or collateral usage.
Base/Ethereum transfers do not require XRPL or XRP as bridge.
Do not record planned collateral support as live without confirmation.

sources.publisher: TokenPost — U.S. altcoin spot ETF flows, citing SoSoValue
claims: TokenPost reports Oct30 U.S. spot XRP ETF net outflow of $496,496 across five funds.
Canary XRPC +$922,005; Bitwise XRP -$693,551; Grayscale GXRP -$724,950.
Cumulative net inflows $1.81B, trading volume $30.92M and net assets $1.42B.
limitations: Secondary aggregation citing SoSoValue; issuer-level reconciliation remains required.
Net redemptions do not prove same-day spot selling; cash/in-kind routes and AP hedges shift timing.
Five-fund universe and cutoff may differ from other providers.

sources.publisher: Alpha Finance — XRP spot ETF flow dashboard
claims: Five-fund series is through Oct29; reports +$8.4M on Oct29, +$98.9M over 30 sessions and about $1.73B cumulative net inflow.
Dashboard publishes flow series but not XRP fund holdings, net assets or fees.
Methodology warns creations can settle after the flow print and redemptions can reflect arbitrage unwinds.
limitations: Cutoff is Oct29, one session earlier than TokenPost/SoSoValue Oct30.
Provider universe and methodology differ; cumulative totals must not be averaged.
No holdings or custody allocation can be inferred.

sources.publisher: CryptoSlate — Why Ripple's $16 trillion payment volume isn't boosting XRP
claims: CryptoSlate distinguishes Ripple's $16T product-enabled volume from XRP-specific payments and reports $13T 2025 Ripple Treasury payment volume.
The analysis notes Ripple products can grow without customers buying XRP; RLUSD can settle directly on Base/Ethereum and some XRPL corridors.
It calculates that one million standard XRPL transactions at 10 drops each burn 10 XRP.
It cites SBI Remit's XRP bridge use and BNY XRP/RLUSD custody support.
limitations: $13T Treasury figure is secondary-reported and not independently reconciled to a primary filing in this run.
Fee calculation assumes standard 10-drop fees and standard transactions.
Editorial analysis is not a substitute for corridor-level XRP volume or inventory data.
